address: Rua de Miguel Bombarda 282, Porto, 4050-377, Portugal
bio: This restaurant could not be in a more fitting spot… on the emblematic Rua Miguel Bombarda, an area of Porto that breathes creativity and forms part of the well-known Arts Quarter. In keeping with the location and the proposal’s identity, here you can see how art and gastronomy share the same space, in an authentic, refined-industrial setting where, naturally, artistic paintings abound to decorate the dining room. Chef Marco Gomes is at the stoves and offers traditional Portuguese cookery with contemporary touches and unique flavours, always seeking to highlight the products of Trás-os-Montes, his native region. Do not forget to peek at the wine list — it is highly recommended!...
